newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal ends firm on demand.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal ends firm on demand.

text.p: Strong nearby cash basis markets and talk of active soymeal exports boosted CBOT soymeal futures to a higher close, traders said.
Gains in soybeans also lent support, they said.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 24,000 contracts, down from 25,709 Thursday. Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 12,000, down from 12,604 Thursday.
Soymeal closed unchanged to $1.50 per ton higher, with December up $1.50 at $228.70. Soyoil was 0.01 to 0.12 cent per lb higher, with December up 0.01 at 23.27.
